mapper.select: SELECT id, trade_date, turnover_amount_yuan, stock_count, amount_record_count, data_source, data_status, calculated_at, created_at, updated_at FROM market_daily_turnover WHERE trade_date = #{tradeDate}
SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM market_daily_turnover WHERE data_status = 'COMPLETE'

SELECT id, trade_date, turnover_amount_yuan, stock_count, amount_record_count, data_source, data_status, calculated_at, created_at, updated_at FROM market_daily_turnover WHERE trade_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND data_status = 'COMPLETE' ORDER BY trade_date
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO market_daily_turnover ( trade_date, turnover_amount_yuan, stock_count, amount_record_count, data_source, data_status, calculated_at ) VALUES ( #{tradeDate}, #{turnoverAmountYuan}, #{stockCount}, #{amountRecordCount}, #{dataSource}, #{dataStatus}, #{calculatedAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE turnover_amount_yuan = VALUES(turnover_amount_yuan), stock_count = VALUES(stock_count), amount_record_count = VALUES(amount_record_count), data_source = VALUES(data_source), data_status = VALUES(data_status), calculated_at = VALUES(calculated_at), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
